description: This file defines tracing functions and macros for Zephyr RTOS kernel thread and synchronization events, integrating with SEGGER SYSVIEW for system profiling and debugging.

methods.name: sys_trace_idle
methods.description: Function to trace idle thread activity.

methods.name: sys_trace_k_thread_create
methods.description: Function to trace creation of a new thread.

methods.name: sys_trace_k_thread_user_mode_enter
methods.description: Function to trace entering user mode in a thread.

methods.name: sys_trace_k_thread_join_blocking
methods.description: Function to trace blocking join on a thread.

methods.name: sys_trace_k_thread_join_exit
methods.description: Function to trace exit of thread join.

methods.name: sys_trace_k_thread_switched_out
methods.description: Function to trace when a thread is switched out.

methods.name: sys_trace_k_thread_switched_in
methods.description: Function to trace when a thread is switched in.

methods.name: sys_trace_k_thread_ready
methods.description: Function to trace when a thread becomes ready.

methods.name: sys_trace_k_thread_pend
methods.description: Function to trace when a thread is pending.
